name: B7·3 Multi-Branch & Enterprise — branch rollup + stock-transfer requests + branch scorecards (3 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step
1. One spreadsheet PER BRANCH (same tab structure as the master: Enquiries, Orders, Stock, StaffSales). Plus one **HQ spreadsheet** with tabs: **Branches** (Name, SheetID, ManagerChatID) and **Transfers** (Date, FromBranch, ToBranch, Item, Qty, Status).
2. Variables: TG_OWNER_CHAT_ID, GEMINI_API_KEY, BRAND_NAME. Attach Telegram + Sheets creds; replace REPLACE_HQ_SHEET_ID.
3. Fill the Branches tab — the rollup loops it automatically; adding branch #3 later = just add a row.

## HOW IT RUNS
• **Daily 21:30 — HQ rollup:** loops every branch sheet → pulls today's enquiries/orders/sales → one consolidated Telegram board (per-branch + group total) → also written to HQ tab **DailyRollup** for history.
• **Stock transfer:** branch manager POSTs `transfer-request` (or you type it) → logged in Transfers → owner gets ✅ approve link → on approve both branch managers are notified with the pick/receive checklist.
• **Mon 08:30 — branch scorecards:** last week's numbers per branch → Gemini writes a 3-line coach note per branch (what to fix this week) → sent to owner (and each manager if ManagerChatID filled).

## 🔧 FIX
• Rollup missing a branch → SheetID wrong or sheet not shared with the connected Google account.
• Loop too slow with many branches → raise the schedule or use n8n queue mode.
• Manager didn't get scorecard → their Telegram must /start the bot once; put their chat ID in Branches.ManagerChatID.
